title: When tragedy strikes, America's wildland firefighters ask, was it 'somebody that we loved?'
summary: Deaths and close calls while fighting wildfires have strained an already on-edge workforce. They've also raised questions about policies and priorities amid an intense wildfire season.
contentText:
